record_type: post-hoc analysis plan written before the matched-mass sensitivity replay; not a preregistration of the original experiment and not a measurement
reason: The original preregistered per-cell cap was not saturated by the candidate in four of eight cells, so the arm-to-arm DTI contrast was not comparable at equal realized mass.

fixed_cap_derivation.rule: minimum realized candidate dots across its eight held-out cells; no manual tuning

changed: Only the maximum dot cap is set to the deterministic common per-cell count so all arms can be scored at matched realized mass.
promotion_rule: The same preregistered rule remains: paired 95% CI lower bound above zero versus no_side, exact dot counts matched in every cell, and no feature-only canary above 0.90. This replay is the final allowed experiment in the three-experiment session budget; no further model/hyperparameter sweeps will follow.
